programmes.d: Helen Torbet visited the Highlands every year. Over time, Don MacMillan Junior, the son of the proprietors, developed what can only be described as an unhealthy obsession with her.
When Patricia Causley disappeared, her husband managed to convince police that she had walked out on her own volition. A decade later, detectives piece together what had really happened.
Percy Mapleton sought a quick fortune and identified Brighton bond trader Isaac Gold as his target. However, his attempted robbery on a moving train turned into an unspeakable tragedy.

The body of Rachel Manning, 19, was found dumped on a Milton Keynes golf course in 2000. In Dec 2000, 21-year-old Barri was sentenced to life in prison for murdering his her, his time in jail saw him beaten and succumb to a devastating addiction.
Louise and the team prove that the evidence is flawed, and the conviction is quashed. Yet it would be 13 years after the murder before her real killer is brought to justice.
Nadine Gurczenski's body was found in a ditch three weeks after the search began. Arntfield and his team try to help her family find closure 14 years later.
Arntfield investigates the death of a nurse that was made to look like suicide.
Parents of a college student have been trying to keep the police investigating their daughters murder, which took place over 40 years ago.
Newlywed Clyde Frost was found dead in his camper, a fax claimed his death was caused by a kidnapping gone wrong, Arntfield tries to track the sender.
Featuring true crime author Geoffrey Wansell as he investigates the case of a killer whose violent fantasies lead him to prey on particularly vulnerable people.
When the body of a homeless teenager is found behind a hotel, the police realise that the most dangerous type of killer is on the loose - the one who attacks strangers.
When a trunk is left at a hotel, with the address of a missing woman's parents inside, police become suspicious and everyone is wondering where the successful chorus girl could have gone.
When tenants at a house receive a note from their live-in landlord to say he has had to rush away, but to give the rent to a named tenant, questions are asked.
In December 2010, Joanna Yeates was found dead in the snow near her home. Within hours her landlord Christopher Jefferies would find himself arrested on suspicion of murder.

Milton Keynes, Buckinghamshire, South East England, UK, In Dec 2000, 21-year-old Barri was sentenced to life in prison for murdering his girlfriend. Louise and the team prove that the evidence is flawed, and the conviction is quashed.
When Devon Guzman is found with her throat cut, investigators think her girlfriend is to blame. However, her ex-girlfriend Michelle and her husband, Brandon are the attackers.
When a neighbourhood quarrel boils over, Billy Woodward decides to strike first. Billy crawls across the street and opens fire, killing two and injuring one.
When three neighbourhood feuds turn deadly, investigators discover years-long arguments over land, rumours, and deer.
When Linda Culbertson calls police about an invasion at her workplace, they assume she is a victim. However, police discover that Linda hired two men to stage the attack.

Emily Kaye was not aware of the past dealings of the handsome Patrick Mahon when she fell head over heels in love with him. Mahon rented a bungalow under an assumed name, murdered her there and dismembered her body.
Paul Teed murdered three of his family members in a nightclub over a dispute over money. He then fled back to his home in Bradford, believing he had the perfect alibi.
Sidney Fox swindled unmarried women and cashed stolen cheques while travelling the country. This eventually led to murder with the intention of claiming the victim's life insurance.
On Valentine's Day Paul Dyson strangled his partner Joanne Nelson to death before removing her body and making it look like she had just disappeared.
After Andre Genestin's wife discovered he had been cheating on her, he murdered her and stored her body in a car roof box in the garden.
Gritty series where crimes are solved using forensic techniques. When a lawyer was battered to death, the beating was so violent that the killer left microscopic evidence at the scene of the crime.
When two women from the same town are murdered in the same way, police fear a serial killer is on the loose. Tiny clues link them to the same man.
When a young woman was found dead on a golf course, the distinctive grass of the course would lead the investigation to her killer.

A teenage girl disappears one night, and her body was found a month later five kilometres from her home. Despite the murderer leaving very little evidence behind, the police have enough to tie him to the crime.
When a popular DJ is found murdered in a local garden, the cops race to find answers. With no other leads, the police turn to a blood spatter expert.
Robert Andrew and his wife Brenda were gunned down in their garage in an upscale neighbourhood in Oklahoma City. The forensic team hope to help find Robert's killer.
